verdict.rationale: Calendly's evidence covers meeting-link scheduling, availability checking, webhooks, routing, and an AI assistant (Callie) that books meetings over email — but nothing shows Calendly autonomously carving out task-focused calendar blocks around deadlines or re-planning tasks when circumstances change. This is a distinct 'AI task scheduler' capability (like Motion/Reclaim) that Calendly's docs and community evidence never describe.
